The principal knowledge-processing activities run locally. Two local supporting services assist: a compliance-reasoning service for internal and external governance reviews, using Qwen 2.5 14B Instruct for Deep Audit and DeepSeek-R1 8B for bounded screening, and a process-diagram service.
